title: Mode constants
description: What stays the same in every mode of one brand: its corners and its type families. Drawn by the ModeConstants composite on Foundations › Theming.

corners.description: Each corner token of the brand.

token.description: The radius token, without radius., such as control.

value.description: Its value as written, such as 0.125rem.

px.description: The value in pixels, such as 2px.

families.description: Each type family the brand uses.

family.description: The family's name, such as IBM Plex Sans.

roles.description: The type roles set in it, such as body.
